Presentation:

Lucas Mollame, Project Manager, Policy Planning
Recommendation:
That report 2026-502 regarding the proposed Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment applications submitted by Build Consulting Services, on behalf of Jaral Properties Inc, to remove the lands from an Employment Area (Schedule 1b: Urban Structure Employment Area of the Official Plan), and permit the proposed Veterinary Service use on the lands municipally known as 501 Hanlon Creek Boulevard, and legally described as Part of Block 3 Plan 61M169 Designated as Part 1, 61R20119 City of Guelph, from Infrastructure, Development and Environment dated December 1, 2026, be received.
That the Official Plan Amendment application submitted by Build Consulting Services, on behalf of Jaral Properties Inc, to remove the lands from an Employment Area (Schedule 1b: Urban Structure Employment Area), and to add a site specific policy to permit the proposed Veterinary Service use on the lands municipally known as 501 Hanlon Creek Boulevard, and legally described as Part of Block 3 Plan 61M169 Designated as Part 1, 61R20119 City of Guelph, be refused in accordance with Attachment-8 of the Infrastructure, Development and Environment report 2026- 502, dated December 1, 2026.
That the Zoning By-law Amendment application submitted by Build Consulting Services, on behalf of Jaral Properties Inc, to change the zoning from the current “Specialized Corporate Business Park” (BP-3) Zone to a revised “Specialized Corporate Business Park” (BP-X) Zone in Zoning By-law (2023)-20790, as amended, to permit the proposed Veterinary Service use on the lands municipally known as 501 Hanlon Creek Boulevard, and legally described as Part of Block 3 Plan 61M169 Designated as Part 1, 61R20119 City of Guelph, be refused in accordance with Attachment-8 of the Infrastructure, Development and Environment report 2026- 502, dated December 1, 2026.
